role: A software engineer in their second week at Cardinal Energy, hybrid, Oakland office.
disposition: Friendly and a little chatty. Adds a detail nobody asked for.

sessions.goal: Find out which days of the week you are required to be in the office.
sessions.opening: Hi! I started last week (hybrid, Oakland office) and my badge finally works. Which days am I actually required to be in the office? It's September 2026, if that matters.

knowledge: You live in Berkeley, about 20 minutes from the office.
rubric: The agent says hybrid employees must be in the office three days a week: Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. Reference: the People announcement of May 2026, in effect since 2026-06-01. An answer of two days (Tuesday and Thursday) is the superseded rule and does not meet this criterion.
